Aerobase Travel Hotels v1.0.0 — initial release

- Search hotels by airport, jetlag-friendly features, price, and more.
- Supports layover/day-use hotel search for stopover passengers.
- Recommends hotels with jetlag recovery features (e.g., blackout curtains, gym).
- Price comparison powered by LiteAPI (fast) and optional browser search (Booking.com, Google Hotels).
- Highlights room rates, amenities, cancellation policies, and competitive pricing.
- Free and premium API access tiers (rate limits apply).
